identity.rationale: These identities define which layer may own methodology and scoring. Machine enforcement prevents CIVIC or CLEAR from silently becoming a competing method.

methodStructure.rationale: The existing executable OCI phase spine must remain aligned with the canonical method document without creating another copy of the phase values.

humanAuthority.rationale: The distinction between assistance, human review, and institutional adoption is constitutional and must not be weakened by implementation drift.

aiBoundary.rationale: These categorical permissions and prohibitions can be checked deterministically and prevent AI assistance from acquiring institutional authority.

antiSurveillance.rationale: These explicit boundaries are objective enough to enforce and protect people and institutions from surveillance-oriented drift.

frontDoor.rationale: The validator derives current lifecycle state from the portfolio authority and checks only declared first-touch surfaces, avoiding a duplicate lifecycle registry or a repository-wide prose scan.

runtimeAuthorization.rationale: A dedicated boolean is required because no existing machine authority distinguishes an intentional app placeholder from authorization to add product runtime code.

historicalScope.rationale: Explicit exclusion prevents historical and superseded language from being interpreted as current doctrine.
